summary: 27 features and 2 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • achievements: add event-based achievement tracking system (8450e9c)
  • standard-phrases: add standard phrase configuration service (81b6408)
  • word-cloud: add time-based keyword ranking algorithm (6a2f4eb)
  • achievements: extend token consumption milestones to one million (e45db64)
  • prompts: add target projects to research investigation prompts (49c0c7e)
  • autotask: add target projects support for research investigation (40b22c0)
  • sessions: add path reference normalization for messages (3199d83)
  • path-references: add path reference service and candidates API (90d69c8)
  • frontend-config: allow summer themes (6180232)
  • session-hero: include profession snapshots (59f2901)
  • data-aggregation: add force refresh support (f72781b)

HagiCode-org/web

  • kanban: add projectId to project detail action (1136fab)
  • git: add AI commit generation API and UI (61b59cc)
  • path-reference: add standard phrase mention support (a50bdbf)
  • achievements: add product behavior groups and achievement events (9caa1a6)
  • standard-phrase: add standard phrase configuration system (76d727f)
  • store: add path reference state and payload handling (78ce735)
  • input: integrate path reference picker in VoiceTextArea (fb83282)
  • achievements: add kanban header achievement rail components (ba72729)
  • research: add project reference selector component (8b723d2)
  • path-reference: add path reference token system (038e284)
  • ui: add collapsed state toggle to status bar and particle effects (6999fa2)
  • kanban: add collapsed state and compact mode to swimlanes (e2af5bb)
  • session: add collapsed state toggle to session list items (ab81b6c)
  • hero: surface profession metadata and GPT 5.5 defaults (59e5084)
  • git: add manual repository list refresh (0e6f241)
  • theme: add summer themes and compact throughput gear (61f3d1e)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • sessions: disable UnitOfWork for Orleans-based session operations (6fe2f70)

HagiCode-org/web

  • session: align markdown list markers (fe2b137)
